title: crates/smtp: RFC 5321 SMTP receive daemon
description:
New binary crate crates/smtp/. Use smtp-server crate (MIT OR Apache-2.0, stalwartlabs) as the SMTP server foundation — it implements RFC 5321 state machine with ESMTP extensions. Add to workspace. Cargo.toml deps: smtp-server (latest), smtp-proto (latest), mail-parser 0.11, mail-auth 0.8 (SPF/DKIM/DMARC/ARC), sieve-rs 0.7, tokio full, rustls + rustls-pemfile + tokio-rustls (STARTTLS), tracing + tracing-subscriber, serde + serde_json, toml 0.8, usenet-ipfs-core (path), usenet-ipfs-sieve (path).

Check smtp-server crate API in ~/.cargo/registry/src/**/smtp-server*/src/ before implementing. The crate likely provides a Server builder + Session trait to implement. Implement: (1) Config (listen addrs for port 25 and 587, TLS cert/key paths, max_message_size_bytes, rate_limit_rpm_per_ip, log level/format); (2) SmtpSession implementing the smtp-server Session trait — accept EHLO, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA; on DATA completion push raw message bytes + envelope into a tokio broadcast/mpsc channel for downstream pipeline; reject unknown RCPT TO with 550 5.1.1; enforce max size at MAIL FROM with 552; (3) main.rs: parse --config flag, init tracing, start smtp-server on configured ports, wire STARTTLS. Ports 25 and 587 both listen; 587 requires STARTTLS before AUTH. Main binary: usenet-ipfs-smtp.
